title: PSX
description: PlayStation games on the centre screen, parked only, with a PS4 or PS5 controller (USB or Bluetooth). Needs the psx-core tool (the emulator, PCSX-ReARMed) from the Store; your own game files on a USB stick.

settings.label: Parked only (pause when the car moves)

config._comment: The emulator is psx-core (native/psx-core, a Store tool): its socket and frames in /dev/shm/psx-core (main.js).
